title: Which search backend is the first adapter, and where do its credentials come from?
statement: DEC-0004 makes the backend replaceable and puts credentials in the PM's host environment, outside the repository. Step 7a still has to pick ONE first adapter and have a working key for it to run a real external question end to end. Which provider, and how is its credential supplied to the extension on this machine?
notes: ⚠️ BLOCKING for 7a step 4 only, under DEC-0002 — and precisely scoped, because most of 7a does not wait on it. `research_fetch` is plain HTTP and needs no credential; tool registration, the capability signature and the live probe are all buildable and testable without a backend, and the probe's most important behaviour is what it reports when the backend is ABSENT — which is exactly the state this question describes. So 7a can be built and its refusal path proven before this is answered; what cannot happen without it is the end-to-end run that produces real evidence(kind: source). ⚠️ It is the PM's to answer because it costs money or a signup and because of where DEC-0004 puts the credential. ⚠️ CORRECTED 2026-08-22: the first phrasing here said 'outside anything this project can read', which is false — the extension MUST read the key to use it. The enforceable boundary is that it stays outside project FILES, planning content, and every MODEL-VISIBLE interface: prompts, logs, errors and tool results. That is a boundary code can hold; the original was a boundary nothing could.
answer: Tavily Search API, basic depth, discovery results only, probed via GET /usage. TAVILY_API_KEY is supplied by the PM through the host environment and injected only into the research child. See DEC-0006.
